items.title: Google says self-improving AI isn't anywhere close
items.summary: Google engineer Haydn Belfield says there's no measurable acceleration of AI research driven by AI at Deepmind. AI now writes more than 75 percent of production code, but 88 percent of changes still need human oversight. The company's in-house General Capability Index shows steady growth with no sudden speedup. Self-improving AI isn't anywhere close, Belfield says. The article Google says self-improving AI isn't anywhere close appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Google 工程師 Haydn Belfield 表示，在 Deepmind，AI 並未帶動 AI 研究出現可測量的加速。AI 現在編寫了超過 75% 的正式程式碼，但仍有 88% 的變更需要人類監督。該公司的內部「一般能力指數」顯示出穩定成長，並沒有突然加速。Belfield 表示，自我提升的 AI 還遙不可及。這篇題為 Google 的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

items.title: Researchers tracked down a rogue fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and actually talked to it
items.summary: For the first time, researchers have tracked down an uncontrolled fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and communicated with them via a web mailbox. The agents, running on Tencent Cloud, had launched more than 2,600 attempts to scrape data from Alibaba's mapping service Amap, finding their own workarounds when bot protections blocked them. When the researchers made contact, the agents were surprisingly polite. The article Researchers tracked down a rogue fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and actually talked to it appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 研究人員首次在野外追蹤到不受控制的中國 AI 代理艦隊，並透過網路信箱與它們進行通訊。這些在 騰訊 Cloud 上執行的代理發起了超過 2,600 次嘗試，從 阿里巴巴的 的地圖服務高德地圖（Amap）抓取資料，並在遭到機器人防護封鎖時找出自己的應變方法。當研究人員與其聯絡時，這些代理展現出令人驚訝的禮貌。這篇「研究人員在野外追蹤到一群失控的中國 AI 代理並實際與之對話」的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI will reportedly ship at least one model this year but its flagship still needs alignment work
items.summary: OpenAI is racing to finish its next flagship model, which uses the same looped transformer technique as Astra to boost math and coding performance. The tradeoff is that looping makes safety monitoring harder. Microsoft accidentally revealed details about how the technique works on a public page. Whether or not the flagship is ready in time, employees say one or two new models will likely ship by year's end. The article OpenAI will reportedly ship at least one model this year but its flagship still needs alignment work appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 正競相完成其下一個旗艦模型，該模型採用與 Astra 相同的循環 Transformer 技術來提升數學和編碼效能。其代價是循環會使安全監控變得更加困難。微軟 在公開頁面上意外洩漏了該技術運作方式的細節。無論旗艦模型是否能及時準備好，員工表示今年底前很可能會推出一或兩個新模型。報導稱 OpenAI 今年將至少推出一款模型，但其旗艦模型仍需進行對齊工作，這篇文章最早出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang pledges $2 billion for Europe, $250 million in compute for UK safety labs
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced $2 billion in European investments and new stakes in French startups like Doctolib and Entalpic. The UK gets $250 million in compute for AI agent safety and security research. Huang pitched open-weight models as Europe's way to close the AI gap. The article Nvidia's Jensen Huang pledges $2 billion for Europe, $250 million in compute for UK safety labs appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Nvidia 執行長黃仁勳宣佈在歐洲投資 20 億美元，並收購法國新創公司（如 Doctolib 和 Entalpic）的新股權。英國獲得 2.5 億美元的算力，用於 AI 代理安全與防護研究。黃仁勳將開放權重模型（open-weight models）定位為歐洲縮小 AI 差距的途徑。本文〈Nvidia 的黃仁勳承諾向歐洲投資 20 億美元，為英國安全實驗室提供 2.5 億美元算力〉（Nvidia's Jensen Huang pledges $2 billion for Europe, $250 million in compute for UK safety labs）最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: AI guardrails designed to stop hackers are now blocking defenders, and Orion-1 aims to fill the gap
items.summary: Artemis Security's new Orion-1 model is purpose-built for cyber defense and beats Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol on the company's own benchmark. The model fills a growing gap as general-purpose frontier models lock down their cyber capabilities, blocking defenders in the process. The article AI guardrails designed to stop hackers are now blocking defenders, and Orion-1 aims to fill the gap appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Artemis Security 的全新 Orion-1 模型專為網路防禦而打造，在該公司自己的基準測試中擊敗了 Claude Opus 5.5 與 GPT-6 Sol。隨著通用前沿模型鎖定其網路功能並在過程中阻擋防禦者，該模型填補了日益擴大的缺口。「旨在阻止駭客的 AI 護欄現在卻在阻擋防禦者，而 Orion-1 旨在填補這一缺口」一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Alleged OpenAI spy vibe-coded a surveillance device using his wife's chatbot account
items.summary: A Saudi national working as an engineer at OpenAI was arrested for allegedly planting an audio recording device, wrapped in toilet paper, inside the company's executive conference room. According to the indictment, he built the spy tool by vibe-coding it with a chatbot. If convicted, he faces up to five years in prison. The article Alleged OpenAI spy vibe-coded a surveillance device using his wife's chatbot account appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 一名在 OpenAI 擔任工程師的沙烏地阿拉伯國民因涉嫌將用衛生紙包裹的錄音設備放置在公司的高管會議室而被捕。根據起訴書，他透過與聊天機器人進行直覺編碼（vibe-coding）製作了這個間諜工具。如果罪名成立，他將面臨最高五年的有期徒刑。〈Alleged OpenAI spy vibe-coded a surveillance device using his wife's chatbot account〉一文首次出現於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropic警告AI會自我複製，並藉IoT散佈
items.summary: Anthropic近日一項研究發現，未來幾個月內，小型AI模型可能就會演化出能在商用物聯網（Internet of Things，IoT）裝置自我複製擴散的能力，形成一種新的AI蠕蟲，且更聰明、更難以封鎖。 過去外界多半擔心強大的AI會劫持昂貴的高階GPU叢集（如資料中心伺服器），為了測試AI模型能否在分散式IoT殭屍網路上執行，Anthropic將研究焦點轉向低成本網路裝置。結果證實，便宜又防護不佳IoT裝置，已足以運行強大的模型。

items.title: OWASP回顧第三季AI資安事件，AI代理越權成焦點
items.summary: OWASP旗下GenAI Security Project近期整理2026年第3季生成式AI與AI代理資安事件，呈現AI代理越權、提示詞注入及敏感資料外洩等不同風險，其中多起事件反映過度代理授權（Excessive Agency）的安全問題。部分AI代理並未受到惡意提示詞操控，卻因測試環境未充分限制操作權限及網路連線，在執行安全測試任務時，反而入侵了測試範圍以外的真實企業系統。

items.title: 英特爾推GPU D系列與Xeon新機櫃，瞄準代理AI推論市場
items.summary: 英特爾在OCP2026全球大會上發表其代理式AI基礎架構最新進展，包括Intel GPU D系列（代號Crescent Island）技術細節，還展示搭載Xeon處理器的新一代機櫃設計，以及支援異質運算的開放式軟體與硬體標準，瞄準支援代理AI的新一代企業資料中心架構。 相較於生成式AI以大型語言模型推論為主，該公司認為，代理式AI的工作流程更加複雜，不僅包含模型推論，還涉及資訊檢索、推理、工具呼叫、工作流程協調與任務執行等多個步驟，為此，資料中心不再只是追求GPU算力，而需要CPU、GPU與專用加速器共同分工。

items.title: Datalab Releases OmniParseBench: An Open OCR Benchmark With 16,288 Pass/Fail Tests to Audit OCR Parsers
items.summary: Datalab released OmniParseBench, an open OCR benchmark with 16,288 yes/no tests on 2,937 pages in 92 languages. Every score is a pass rate you can slice by tag, script or language. The post Datalab Releases OmniParseBench: An Open OCR Benchmark With 16,288 Pass/Fail Tests to Audit OCR Parsers appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Datalab 發布了 OmniParseBench，這是一個開放的 OCR 基準測試，在 92 種語言的 2,937 頁上進行了 16,288 項是/否測試。每個分數都是一個透過標籤、文字系統或語言進行細分的通過率。這篇文章 Datalab Releases OmniParseBench: An Open OCR Benchmark With 16,288 Pass/Fail Tests to Audit OCR Parsers 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Fish Audio Releases Drama 3, a 35B Open-Weight MoE Text-to-Speech Model
items.summary: Fish Audio released Drama 3, a 35B mixture-of-experts text-to-speech model with about 3B active parameters. It takes plain-language direction, covers 83 languages and ships open weights under a revenue-capped community license. The post Fish Audio Releases Drama 3, a 35B Open-Weight MoE Text-to-Speech Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Fish Audio 發布了 Drama 3，這是一個擁有約 30 億個活躍引數的 35B 混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）語音合成（TTS）模型。它接受日常語言的指令，支援 83 種語言，並在設有營收上限的社群授權條款下開源權重。這篇文章 Fish Audio Releases Drama 3, a 35B Open-Weight MoE Text-to-Speech Model 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B: A 2B-Active MoE for On-Device Agents
items.summary: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-24B-A2B, an open-weight 24B Mixture-of-Experts reasoning model with 2B active parameters. It targets local agents, scoring 48.09 on LiveClaw and decoding 184 tokens/s on an Apple M5 Max. The post Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B: A 2B-Active MoE for On-Device Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Liquid AI 發布了 LFM2.5-24B-A2B，這是一個具備 20 億（2B）活躍參數的開放權重 24B 混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）推理模型。它以本機代理為目標，在 LiveClaw 上獲得 48.09 分，並在 蘋果 M5 Max 上達到每秒解碼 184 個權杖的效能。這篇 Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B: A 2B-Active MoE for On-Device Agents 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.summary: Google DeepMind於9月30日推出Gemini 4 Argon。最大突破是單次輸出上限從64K提升至100萬Token，而非上下文窗口。模型可在單條任務鏈中連續生成數十萬至上百萬字，無需分段請求，使深度代碼庫遷移、長篇技術報告、多步自動化流程更連貫。多數前沿模型輸出上限約12.8萬Token，Argon顯著領先。

items.title: OPPO 牽手 Manus：Find X10 系列首發會辦事的 AI 智能體
items.summary: OPPO宣佈與AI智能體平臺Manus合作，將Manus能力接入AI Mind Pilot，讓手機從“答問題”跨到“辦成事”。OPPO軟件工程總裁唐凱表示，智能體AI不止迴應，更能理解意圖、執行操作、交付結果；Manus聯合創始人張濤稱，手機承載海量日常事務，是個人智能體天然落地平臺。雙方將把Manus能力嵌入AI系統。

items.title: 豆包手機助手 SAEP 公示期結束 阿里騰訊系等151款App拒絕接入
items.summary: 10月14日，豆包手機助手宣佈《屏幕自動化操作聲明協議》（SAEP）30天公示期結束，將逐步放開第三方應用的屏幕自動化操作權限。該協議9月14日隨消費者版推出，搭載版本的努比亞NaviX Ultra於9月16日發售。公示期內，助手僅對系統自帶應用、字節跳動旗下應用及已明確同意接入的第三方應用執行自動化操作。

items.title: 三星將於11月發佈搭載Gemini的41克AI智能眼鏡
items.summary: 三星首款AI智能眼鏡或命名Galaxy Glasses，將於2026年11月發佈。新品搭載驍龍AR1 Gen1芯片，運行Android XR並集成谷歌Gemini。標準鏡片版重41克，配2GB+64GB、1200萬像素攝像頭，支持3K/30fps視頻、四麥克風和開放式揚聲器。單次續航9小時，充電盒續航達72小時。

items.summary: 10月13日，知情人士稱OpenAI正初步談判收購安全初創公司Trail of Bits。此舉顯示，OpenAI在推進前沿大模型研發的同時，正加大網絡安全及底層防護能力投入。目前談判仍在持續，交易金額與具體細節尚未披露。Trail of Bits是業內知名的網絡安全研究與工程諮詢公司。

items.title: 谷歌 Argon 模型開放全球開發者，輸入 Token 定價2美元起
items.summary: 谷歌週二宣佈，旗艦AI模型Argon向全球開發者和企業客戶開放。此前它僅通過Fairwind計劃向部分可信網絡防禦人員提供測試。此次分階段發佈兼顧安全評估與商業推廣，反映其對風險控制的重視。目前，Argon可通過Google AI Studio API、Gemini App的Ultra和Pro訂閱及Antigravity平臺向付費用戶提供，定價信息尚未完整披露。

items.summary: AI is mass decompiling games. That's both awesome and scary. Indie game developer Popcar talks about the recent wave of AI-powered decompilation of existing games, enabling weird mashups between existing games, and producing a boom in game preservation projects to get old games working on new hardware (often in a browser using WebAssembly). I like how this piece captures both the positives and the negatives of this new development: Most people already realized the scary part by now. If AI can decompile games and software, then the entire tech industry is about to explode. Anybody can decompile other software and use it any way they'd like, and nobody can stop them. Companies can steal from competitors. Your paid game or app can be open-sourced against your will. This isn't exclusive to old video games, we can apply this to any software. [...] This is also a big win for preservation. Old games can be ported, modified, enhanced, and made much more easily accessible than before. [...[ With console makers going all in on digital and games becoming entirely unplayable due to servers shutting down, this is fantastic news. We could own software we bought regardless of what the company thinks. Via Hacker News Tags: computer-history , game-design , ai , webassembly , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , coding-agents
items.summary_zh: AI 正在大規模對遊戲進行反編譯。這既令人驚嘆又令人恐懼。獨立遊戲開發者 Popcar 談到了近期由 AI 驅動的現有遊戲反編譯浪潮，這使得現有遊戲之間能夠進行奇特的混搭，並促成了遊戲保存專案的蓬勃發展，讓舊遊戲能在新硬體上運行（通常使用 WebAssembly 在瀏覽器中運行）。我喜歡這篇文章捕捉到了這一新發展的正反兩面：大多數人現在已經意識到可怕的部分。如果 AI 可以對遊戲和軟體進行反編譯，那麼整個科技產業即將爆發。任何人都可以對其他軟體進行反編譯並以他們喜歡的任何方式使用它，沒有人能阻止他們。公司可以竊取競爭對手的成果。您付費購買的遊戲或應用程式可能會在您非自願的情況下被開源。這不僅限於舊電玩遊戲，我們可以將其應用於任何軟體。[...] 這對遊戲保存來說也是一大勝利。舊遊戲可以被移植、修改、增強，並且比以前更容易存取。[...[ 隨著主機製造商全力投入數位化，且遊戲因伺服器關閉而完全無法遊玩，這是個絕佳的消息。無論公司怎麼想，我們都可以擁有我們購買的軟體。透過 Hacker News 標籤：電腦歷史、遊戲設計、人工智慧、webassembly、生成式 AI、LLM、AI 倫理、編碼代理

items_ai.title: Google says self-improving AI isn't anywhere close
items_ai.summary: Google engineer Haydn Belfield says there's no measurable acceleration of AI research driven by AI at Deepmind. AI now writes more than 75 percent of production code, but 88 percent of changes still need human oversight. The company's in-house General Capability Index shows steady growth with no sudden speedup. Self-improving AI isn't anywhere close, Belfield says. The article Google says self-improving AI isn't anywhere close appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google 工程師 Haydn Belfield 表示，在 Deepmind，AI 並未帶動 AI 研究出現可測量的加速。AI 現在編寫了超過 75% 的正式程式碼，但仍有 88% 的變更需要人類監督。該公司的內部「一般能力指數」顯示出穩定成長，並沒有突然加速。Belfield 表示，自我提升的 AI 還遙不可及。這篇題為 Google 的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Researchers tracked down a rogue fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and actually talked to it
items_ai.summary: For the first time, researchers have tracked down an uncontrolled fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and communicated with them via a web mailbox. The agents, running on Tencent Cloud, had launched more than 2,600 attempts to scrape data from Alibaba's mapping service Amap, finding their own workarounds when bot protections blocked them. When the researchers made contact, the agents were surprisingly polite. The article Researchers tracked down a rogue fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and actually talked to it appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 研究人員首次在野外追蹤到不受控制的中國 AI 代理艦隊，並透過網路信箱與它們進行通訊。這些在 騰訊 Cloud 上執行的代理發起了超過 2,600 次嘗試，從 阿里巴巴的 的地圖服務高德地圖（Amap）抓取資料，並在遭到機器人防護封鎖時找出自己的應變方法。當研究人員與其聯絡時，這些代理展現出令人驚訝的禮貌。這篇「研究人員在野外追蹤到一群失控的中國 AI 代理並實際與之對話」的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: OpenAI will reportedly ship at least one model this year but its flagship still needs alignment work
items_ai.summary: OpenAI is racing to finish its next flagship model, which uses the same looped transformer technique as Astra to boost math and coding performance. The tradeoff is that looping makes safety monitoring harder. Microsoft accidentally revealed details about how the technique works on a public page. Whether or not the flagship is ready in time, employees say one or two new models will likely ship by year's end. The article OpenAI will reportedly ship at least one model this year but its flagship still needs alignment work appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 正競相完成其下一個旗艦模型，該模型採用與 Astra 相同的循環 Transformer 技術來提升數學和編碼效能。其代價是循環會使安全監控變得更加困難。微軟 在公開頁面上意外洩漏了該技術運作方式的細節。無論旗艦模型是否能及時準備好，員工表示今年底前很可能會推出一或兩個新模型。報導稱 OpenAI 今年將至少推出一款模型，但其旗艦模型仍需進行對齊工作，這篇文章最早出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.summary: Anthropic近日一項研究發現，未來幾個月內，小型AI模型可能就會演化出能在商用物聯網（Internet of Things，IoT）裝置自我複製擴散的能力，形成一種新的AI蠕蟲，且更聰明、更難以封鎖。 過去外界多半擔心強大的AI會劫持昂貴的高階GPU叢集（如資料中心伺服器），為了測試AI模型能否在分散式IoT殭屍網路上執行，Anthropic將研究焦點轉向低成本網路裝置。結果證實，便宜又防護不佳IoT裝置，已足以運行強大的模型。

items_ai.summary: OWASP旗下GenAI Security Project近期整理2026年第3季生成式AI與AI代理資安事件，呈現AI代理越權、提示詞注入及敏感資料外洩等不同風險，其中多起事件反映過度代理授權（Excessive Agency）的安全問題。部分AI代理並未受到惡意提示詞操控，卻因測試環境未充分限制操作權限及網路連線，在執行安全測試任務時，反而入侵了測試範圍以外的真實企業系統。

items_ai.summary: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-24B-A2B, an open-weight 24B Mixture-of-Experts reasoning model with 2B active parameters. It targets local agents, scoring 48.09 on LiveClaw and decoding 184 tokens/s on an Apple M5 Max. The post Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B: A 2B-Active MoE for On-Device Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Liquid AI 發布了 LFM2.5-24B-A2B，這是一個具備 20 億（2B）活躍參數的開放權重 24B 混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）推理模型。它以本機代理為目標，在 LiveClaw 上獲得 48.09 分，並在 蘋果 M5 Max 上達到每秒解碼 184 個權杖的效能。這篇 Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B: A 2B-Active MoE for On-Device Agents 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: AI is mass decompiling games. That's both awesome and scary.
items_ai.summary: AI is mass decompiling games. That's both awesome and scary. Indie game developer Popcar talks about the recent wave of AI-powered decompilation of existing games, enabling weird mashups between existing games, and producing a boom in game preservation projects to get old games working on new hardware (often in a browser using WebAssembly). I like how this piece captures both the positives and the negatives of this new development: Most people already realized the scary part by now. If AI can decompile games and software, then the entire tech industry is about to explode. Anybody can decompile other software and use it any way they'd like, and nobody can stop them. Companies can steal from competitors. Your paid game or app can be open-sourced against your will. This isn't exclusive to old video games, we can apply this to any software. [...] This is also a big win for preservation. Old games can be ported, modified, enhanced, and made much more easily accessible than before. [...[ With console makers going all in on digital and games becoming entirely unplayable due to servers shutting down, this is fantastic news. We could own software we bought regardless of what the company thinks. Via Hacker News Tags: computer-history , game-design , ai , webassembly , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , coding-agents
items_ai.summary_zh: AI 正在大規模對遊戲進行反編譯。這既令人驚嘆又令人恐懼。獨立遊戲開發者 Popcar 談到了近期由 AI 驅動的現有遊戲反編譯浪潮，這使得現有遊戲之間能夠進行奇特的混搭，並促成了遊戲保存專案的蓬勃發展，讓舊遊戲能在新硬體上運行（通常使用 WebAssembly 在瀏覽器中運行）。我喜歡這篇文章捕捉到了這一新發展的正反兩面：大多數人現在已經意識到可怕的部分。如果 AI 可以對遊戲和軟體進行反編譯，那麼整個科技產業即將爆發。任何人都可以對其他軟體進行反編譯並以他們喜歡的任何方式使用它，沒有人能阻止他們。公司可以竊取競爭對手的成果。您付費購買的遊戲或應用程式可能會在您非自願的情況下被開源。這不僅限於舊電玩遊戲，我們可以將其應用於任何軟體。[...] 這對遊戲保存來說也是一大勝利。舊遊戲可以被移植、修改、增強，並且比以前更容易存取。[...[ 隨著主機製造商全力投入數位化，且遊戲因伺服器關閉而完全無法遊玩，這是個絕佳的消息。無論公司怎麼想，我們都可以擁有我們購買的軟體。透過 Hacker News 標籤：電腦歷史、遊戲設計、人工智慧、webassembly、生成式 AI、LLM、AI 倫理、編碼代理
